name: Ifrit Legendary Slayer (CR 7)
body:
Ifrit Legendary Slayer CR 7

Ifrit Legendary Slayer 8
CG Medium outsider (native)
Init +4 Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 14, flat-footed 14 (armor +4, Dex +4)
hp 46 (8d10-8)
Fort +5, Ref ++10, Will ++1
Resist fire 5

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk cutlass +10/+5 (1d6+1/18-20) or dagger +12/+7 (1d4+1/19-20)
Ranged mwk pistol +13 (1d8/x4) or dagger +12/+7 (1d4+1/19-20)
Special Attacks combat tactics, advanced tactics (sniping +2d8)
Spell-like Abilities (CL 8th, concentration +11)

1/day–burning hands (DC 14)

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 18, Con 8, Int 13, Wis 8, Cha 16
Base Attack +8; CMB +9, CMD 23
Feats Always a ThreatB, Deadly AimB, Exotic Weapon Proficiency (pistol), Gunsmithing, Leadership, Quick DrawB, Rapid Reload, Weapon FinesseB
Skills Acrobatics +9, Bluff +9, Climb +13, Craft (sailmaking) +10, Intimidate +10, Knowledge (geography) +8 (+12 for navigating at sea), Knowledge (local) +5, Lore (sailing) +10, Perception +6, Profession (sailor) +9, Sense Motive +6, Stealth +9, Survival +7, Swim +20; +4 bonus on Appraise, Craft, Knowledge, Lore and Profession checks related to sailing
Languages Common, Aquan, Ignan
SQ evasion, get the job done (day job [sailor], explorer), leadership score (13), slayer talents (combat trick, finesse rogue, graceful athlete, ranger combat style [crossbow])
Gear masterwork cutlass, 3 daggers, 2 masterwork pistols, 30 bullets, +1 studded leather armor, feather token (anchor), potion of water breathing, ring of swimming, nautical navigation equipment and maps (325 gp), 49 gp
